sources.role: pinned Proton source and Linux/Steam compatibility-layer scope
official description of Proton as a Steam/Linux Wine compatibility tool
Proton-level user-settings hook; game configuration and controller mapping remain title/frontend-owned

paths.path: user_settings.py per Proton version dir plus <compatdata>/<appid>/pfx/*.reg prefix hives
paths.naming: user_settings.py takes effect for all games in that Proton version; prefix registry is title-local.

paths.path: Steam Input per-title mapping with xinput passthrough (SteamVirtualGamepadInfo); Xalia gamepad UI optional
paths.naming: Controllers route through Steam Input; Proton bridges xinput DLLs and the Steam virtual gamepad.
Game saves live inside the prefix drive_c tree or Steam userdata; both key off the title appid.
evidence: source:ValveSoftware/Proton proton CompatData prefix_dir and drive_c/users/steamuser paths @5b89db940e0ebe3a137a6009a3589232fe084c09

paths.path: No snapshot facility in the Proton runtime
paths.naming: No snapshot slots or state filename grammar in the reviewed source.
evidence: source:ValveSoftware/Proton proton script defines no snapshot writer @5b89db940e0ebe3a137a6009a3589232fe084c09

paths.path: No BIOS or firmware file required
paths.naming: Windows titles ship their own content; Proton supplies Wine/DXVK/vkd3d runtimes, not firmware.
evidence: source:ValveSoftware/Proton README.md Proton as Wine-based Steam tool @5b89db940e0ebe3a137a6009a3589232fe084c09

paths.path: No external cryptographic key material required
paths.naming: No encrypted firmware or key files.
evidence: source:ValveSoftware/Proton proton script defines no key store @5b89db940e0ebe3a137a6009a3589232fe084c09

linux-flatpak.reason: A Steam/Proton Flatpak sandbox is frontend- and game-specific; the pinned Proton source provides no Flatpak package manifest or sandbox path contract for the six catalog purposes.
evidence: source:README.md directs users to Proton supplied by the Steam client @5b89db9
source:Proton source tree has no Flatpak manifest or universal sandbox persistence contract @5b89db9

windows.reason: The official Proton README defines Proton as a Linux/Steam compatibility tool and does not publish a native Windows host target.
evidence: source:README.md Proton runs Windows-exclusive games on Linux via Wine @5b89db9

macos.reason: The pinned Proton source documents Linux as its host operating system and does not publish a native macOS host target.
evidence: source:README.md Proton runs Windows-exclusive games on Linux via Wine @5b89db9

controller_boundary.refusal: Do not invent a Proton controller profile: Proton is a compatibility layer and does not own a stable game-specific host-controller mapping, save/state, firmware, or key contract. Inspect the individual game's runtime, Wine prefix, Steam Input configuration, and save/state format separately.

notes: Proton is cataloged as a compatibility layer, not as a console emulator with one persistence namespace. Runtime game launch, Steam Input behavior, and title-specific persistence were not verified by this record.
